verdict.rationale: Grafana's source is public at github.com/grafana/grafana. Community discussion consistently says it is licensed under AGPLv3, a FOSS license, since Grafana 8, and Grafana Labs' docs refer to 'Grafana OSS'. Licensing concerns raised in the community are about corporate policy, not about whether the code is open, so they do not create a dispute. missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license in the evidence (e.g., the LICENSE file or official licensing docs), and clarity on which Enterprise features fall outside the open-source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
